title: Keto Syrian Cabbage Gratin
description: A rich and satisfying keto dish featuring caramelized cabbage and a creamy, umami-rich gratin.
instructions: In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add sliced cabbage to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10-12 minutes, until caramelized.
In a separate saucepan, combine chicken broth and heavy cream. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the cream mixture by half, stirring occasionally.
Stir in parmesan cheese until melted and smooth.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of caramelized cabbage.
Pour the cream mixture over the cabbage, followed by a layer of grated gratin.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of gratin on top.
In a small bowl, whisk together eggs and nutmeg (if using). Pour the egg mixture over the top of the gratin.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is set.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley or chives if desired.
